items.title: Jim Cramer Says a 25% Surtax Just Got Added to Everything You Buy. Congress Never Voted on It.
items.summary: Jim Cramer put a precise number on what diesel is doing to every product you buy, and the math he laid out on CNBC has nothing to do with the inflation figure Washington reports. What it means for McDonald's, Walmart, and Target stocks depends on how long one critical cushion holds.
